title: Can a larger human-reference-qualified teaching cohort improve Granite before optimizing the selector?
scope: A new source/curriculum-transfer development study. It is separate from the running three-source grid and does not imply that larger budgets, human references, or skill selection will improve Granite.

observed_evidence.interpretation: Current data-selection controls have not beaten the matching base. Overfitting, source mismatch, optimization recipe, capacity, and inference protocol are hypotheses to diagnose, not established explanations.

human_reference_qualified_pool.training_response_origin: DeepSeek nonthinking answers checked against human GSM8K references; these are not human-authored training responses
human_reference_qualified_pool.eligibility_limit: Exact annotation arithmetic and matching final numbers do not prove all natural-language semantics or explanation steps. Detectable ancestry exclusions are conservative, not complete decontamination.

observed_evidence.new_development_role: Separately frozen official-training-split holdout, declared unused at design time. It is development, never the official final test.

recommended_smallest_study.prospective_policy: Declare the selector rules, old weakness-signal source, model/optimizer settings, and continuation/abort criteria before baseline200 is observed. After baseline200 completes, use its runtime/truncation measurements to validate feasibility before freezing and launching the paired64k plans. Do not use its question-level errors to retune the initial pair's selector.
recommended_smallest_study.study_kind: Seed42 exploratory source/curriculum transfer, not a robust causal selector result or multi-seed finding.
recommended_smallest_study.why64k_first: Uses29.28 percent of the available teacher tokens, provides selection contrast, and tests more training on a matching human-reference task distribution without buying another teacher pool. A new gradient datastore is unnecessary for the smallest useful comparison.
primary_outcomes: Paired numeric correctness change of each adapter versus the matching untouched base on200.
Paired skill-minus-random corrected and regressed counts on those same200.
Truncation and format failures reported separately from arithmetic/reference mismatch.
Supervised tokens, updates, examples, forwarded input tokens, response-window count, runtime and end-to-end cost.
recommended_smallest_study.continuation: Review the completed64k pair and seed43 evidence from the existing study before choosing another paid intervention. If both human arms regress, prioritize one isolated recipe diagnosis over automatically doubling tokens. A useful candidate must survive error audit and later confirmation; a gain is not guaranteed.

fixed_first_pair_recipe.optimizer: Current AdamW defaults, constant learning rate, gradient norm clip1.0
fixed_first_pair_recipe.reason: Hold the current recipe and common base fixed so the first human-pool comparison is not simultaneously a learning-rate, adapter-capacity, or inference-mode experiment.
fixed_first_pair_recipe.later_isolated_ablation: Only after reviewing the first pair, a separately versioned one-factor comparison may change learning rate, for example2e-5 versus1e-5 at the same pool/selection/seed/token budget. Rank, target modules, thinking mode and output cap stay fixed in that ablation. Do not change several axes to force a favorable result.

token_and_runtime_feasibility.forecast_method: Scale observed non-evaluation time by exact prepared forwarded-input/window ratios, add the newly measured baseline200 evaluation cost, and retain a substantial cold-start/throughput margin. Answer-token budgets alone do not predict runtime.
token_and_runtime_feasibility.range_limitations: The skill arm is not selected yet. Larger forwarded-token/window counts can increase its cost. New200 output lengths are unmeasured; if many generations approach512 tokens, evaluation can exceed projections based on the old64. Baseline200 calibration is mandatory before dispatch.
token_and_runtime_feasibility.128k_policy: Defer until measured64k training and baseline200 costs support the same<=1250-second reviewed forecast with300 seconds margin. No automatic128k escalation. At131072 tokens there are128 optimizer updates and approximately double the64k forwarded work.
token_and_runtime_feasibility.current_guard_gap: The current immutable worker actually checks training at1400 seconds and evaluation at1600; it does not enforce a global1550 guard from a plan field. Keep it unchanged. If a literal1550 application guard is required, create and audit a separate versioned human-study worker/helper rather than claiming a new JSON field changes pinned behavior. Otherwise explicitly retain the current guards and use the stricter prospective feasibility ceiling.

success_and_stop_rules.success: A reproducible candidate with better paired accuracy or a clearly useful accuracy/latency tradeoff against the same200 untouched base, followed by an independent confirmatory evaluation. A null or regressive result is still retained.
immediate_stop: Nonfinite training loss or invalid exact-token accounting
